read_property_value: read a property value by key from a dm_env_rpc server using PropertiesExtension
write_property_value: write a scalar or numpy array value to a property on a dm_env_rpc server
list_property_specs: list all available property specs under a given key path via PropertiesExtension
get_property_spec_dict: get a dictionary mapping property keys to PropertySpec objects for a given key path
inspect_property_spec: inspect a PropertySpec to check its key, readable, writable, listable, and description attributes
